title: Error receiving too much data
symptom: The user reports that with a Huawei P30 (Android 10) and a Libre sensor, calibrations became very inaccurate and deleting too many calibrations caused the whole setup to fail. The error message 'error receiving too much data' appears and the app refuses to start, even after reinstalling.
evidence_quote: I keep getting the error message that says 'error receiving too much data' and it refuses to start up.
